answer_text:
To determine the reservoir pressure $ P_R $ using the internal production-system pressure-balance relation, the formula is:

$$
P_R = P_{\text{separator}} + \text{Total System Pressure Loss}
$$

Given:
- Total System Pressure Loss = 1740 psi
- Separator Pressure $ P_{\text{separator}} $ = 160 psi

$$
P_R = 160 \, \text{psi} + 1740 \, \text{psi} = 1900 \, \text{psi}
$$

**Formula span:** $ P_R = P_{\text{separator}} + \text{Total System Pressure Loss} $
